CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 18, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Juarez, Mojarro

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner; Vanessa Norwood, Contract Senior Planner;
  Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney; Tiffany Chew, Economic Development
  Specialist

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – March 4, 2024 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the March 4, 2024, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the March 4, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Juarez, Mojarro

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-30 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 36 & 40 West Bay State Street
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Conditional
  Use Permit CUP-23-30 to allow a Buddhist cultural worship hall,
  religious teaching center, and related offices, located within two (2)
  existing commercial buildings with a combined floor area of
  approximately 5,658 square feet located in the CBD (Central Business
  District) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-07 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-30 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval, and finding Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-30 to be
  exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the
  California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review
  projects that are existing facilities.
  • Contract Senior Planner Vanessa Norwood provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • Zhen Liu and Henry Wu, the Applicant and property owner,
  respectively, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Juarez, Mojarro

  2
  03/18/2024
 AGENDA
ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-58, CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-23-24, AND LOT MERGER LOTM-23-07 (7:10
  P.M.)
  • 1303, 1325, and 1345 West Main Street
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-58, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-24,
  and Lot Merger LOTM-23-07 to construct and operate a two-story,
  19,771 square foot automotive dealership and to merge three (3)
  parcels into one (1) parcel on an approximate 1.04-acre site located in
  the CPD (Commercial Planned Development) zone and AC
  (Automobile Commercial) Overlay District.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-04 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-58, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-24,
  and Lot Merger LOTM-23-07 subject to the Conditions of Approval,
  and finding Planned Development Permit PD-23-58, Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-23-24, and Lot Merger LOTM-23-07 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15332, Class 32 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  characterized as in-fill development.
  • Contract Senior Planner Vanessa Norwood provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • Bryan Mac Dermott (Wagner Architecture Group) and Daniel
  Lin (Glendale Auto Properties), the Applicant and property owner,
  respectively, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with one (1) additional condition of approval to extend
  the proposed additional greenscreen area towards the west as much as is
  feasible.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Juarez, Mojarro

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING

  •  There were no Comments or Conference/Meeting Reports from the Planning

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  Deputy Director Reynoso provided information regarding potential agenda items for
  the next Planning Commission meeting, including the election of officers and a legal
  update provided by the Deputy City Attorney. Deputy Director Reynoso also provided
  an update on the preparation of multi-family design guidelines and the forthcoming
  presentation of the Historic Survey Report to the City Council. (7:30 P.M.)
